title: Portuguese Beef Burger
description: A keto twist on the classic burger, featuring a beef patty topped with crunchy lettuce, tomato, and melted cheese.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine ground beef, Portuguese spice blend, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal portions and shape into patties.
4. Brush the grill or grill pan with egg wash to prevent sticking.
5. Grill the beef patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
6. Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill if using.
7. Assemble the burgers with lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
